per-job model record: budgets, RNG streams, pairing fingerprints, per-epoch validation curves for both loss versions, selection
selected checkpoints and SSL artifacts with weight fingerprints; reload parity (load_forecaster -> identical validation predictions)
validation ForecastPrediction per model/seed adapted to EvaluationRecord (M4B adapter) and loss_panel_from_records accepted on validation only
measured wall time and per-job peak RSS; storage footprint
quantile-linear lambda path: validation metric, mean squared coefficient, raw crossing fraction per lambda

any nonfinite loss, gradient, prediction or crossing native quantile

reporting pilot validation differences as evidence about JEPA value
